messages:
incidents-bot: Pager -> billing-metering anomaly detected (severity: P2). alert_id=AM-20260318-09 link=https://redwood.internal/alerts/AM-20260318-09

alex kim: Oncall alex here, looking into it.

alex kim: Initial symptom: sudden jump in billed tokens for a subset of customers + support reports of overage emails. Are these real charges or delayed emits?

maya patel: Support seeing 3 tickets so far, customers reporting invoices & overage emails sent ~15m ago.

billing-alert-bot: Automated telemetry: usage-collector (eu-west-1) showing increased ack latency and an emitter replay spike. Backlog ~= 28m messages, reemit-rate elevated. Sample log:```
2026-03-18T10:01:12Z usage-collector[pid=214] WARN ack_delay=1800ms backlog=174k
2026-03-18T10:02:05Z emitter[pid=47] INFO reemit batch=512 dup_detected=true
```

jordan li: Running quick reconcile against token_ledger:```sql
SELECT sum(tokens) - sum(last_24h_tokens) AS delta FROM token_ledger WHERE emitted_at > now() - interval '1 hour';
-- result: +2,340,212 tokens (unexpected)
```

alex kim: That delta screams replayed usage. Two immediate asks: (1) mute overage-alert rule so customers stop receiving billing emails, (2) hold automatic invoicing until we confirm. Can someone execute?

maya patel: I'll coordinate comms and mute support notifications. Posting to status page after we confirm mitigation.

billing-alert-bot: Running pre-checks for mute: current_alert_count=7, muteable=true.

sara chen: I can patch the emitter to enable dedupe-mode (passthrough->dedupe) to prevent further duplicate emits. Rolling patch now.

deploy-bot: started rollout emitter/dedupe v2 -> svc/emitter-eu-west-1 (replicas=4)

alex kim: Command to mute alerts: `/billing mute-overage-rule --scope=eu-west-1 --reason="inflight replay suspected"`

maya patel: Executed mute and told support to stop escalation. Creating incident ticket INC-20260318-21 and adding customers in affected list. Status page draft ready.

billing-alert-bot: Mute successful. Note added to alert: "muted by maya patel during mitigation - will unmute after verification"

jordan li: After patch, sampling 1k records shows no duplicate external_ids; ledger delta rolling back. Drain metrics: backlog -> 12m messages, drain_rate ~3k/s.

sara chen: Emitter patch confirmed: dedupe-mode active, checking for any replays in last 10m: none found in sample. Patching kube rollout finished.

alex kim: Good. Keep monitoring for 30m. If we see a secondary spike or >5 customer complaints escalate to P1.

maya patel: Posted status update to status.redwood.ai and notified affected customers with temporary credit offer. Support queue updated.

billing-alert-bot: Reconcile job scheduled: `/billing reconcile --since=2026-03-18T09:30:00Z --scope=eu-west-1 --dry-run` (will post results to thread).

jordan li: Dry-run shows duplicate window isolated to 09:40-10:05 UTC, estimated duplicate tokens ~2.1M. Will prepare adjustments to invoices (credit proposals).

sara chen: Confirmed emitter logs clean post-rollout. No further reemits.

alex kim: Closing the active page to monitoring-only. Leaving incident open for billing reconciliation. If everything stabilizes by +1h we can mark resolved. :thumbsup:

maya patel: Acknowledged. I'll follow up with the billing team and post final customer note once credits are applied.

billing-alert-bot: Next update scheduled in 15m.

alex kim: thanks team, nice mitigation.
